question: Which of the following institutes was founded by Mrinalini Sarabhai who was a Bharatanatyam and Kathakali dancer?

options.text: Sri Thyagaraja College of Music and Dance

solution:
The correct answer is __**Darpana Academy of Performing Arts**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• **Darpana Academy of Performing Arts** was founded by the renowned Bharatanatyam and Kathakali dancer Mrinalini Sarabhai.
 
• The institute was established in 1949 in Ahmedabad, Gujarat, India.
 
• Darpana Academy is dedicated to preserving and promoting various Indian classical dance forms, including Bharatanatyam and Kathakali.
 
• The academy has grown into a multidisciplinary arts center, offering training in dance, music, theatre, and puppetry.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Mrinalini Sarabhai**

 
 
• Mrinalini Sarabhai (1918-2016) was a celebrated Indian classical dancer, choreographer, and instructor who was known for her contributions to Bharatanatyam and Kathakali.
 
• She received numerous awards and honors, including the Padma Bhushan and Padma Shri, for her significant contributions to Indian classical dance.
 
• Mrinalini Sarabhai was also an author and wrote several books on classical dance and Indian culture.
 
 
 
• **Bharatanatyam**
 
 
• Bharatanatyam is one of the oldest classical dance forms of India, originating from Tamil Nadu.
 
• It is known for its fixed upper torso, bent legs, intricate footwork, and expressive hand gestures and facial expressions.
 
• Bharatanatyam is traditionally performed by solo dancers, often telling stories through dance.
 
 
 
• **Kathakali**
 
 
• Kathakali is a classical Indian dance-drama form that originated in Kerala.
 
• It is characterized by elaborate costumes, detailed makeup, and well-defined body movements, all of which are used to tell stories from Indian epics and mythology.
 
• Kathakali performances are traditionally performed by male dancers, although women now also perform.
